title: Createcraft Modpack
description: This Modpack is required to join the CreateCraft server
body:
The CreateCraft Official Modpack is the required modpack for joining the CreateCraft server. It comes preloaded with the Create mod, adding incredible mechanical and automation possibilities to your Minecraft world. Explore complex machines, transport systems, and creative contraptions while enjoying a smooth and balanced gameplay experience.

This modpack is carefully configured for full compatibility with the server, making it the perfect foundation for your adventures in CreateCraft. Build, automate, and craft like never before!
